about: Pet Shelf queue, Fri 13 - Wed 18 Nov 2026. Booked automatically the evening before. Boss rule: no reply by 08:00 = posts go out.

posts.caption:
Muddy paws at the door?
This dog paw cleaner cup (medium): twist the paw in the cup and wipe it clean.
Good for: muddy walks, medium-size paws. Not for: dogs with paws wider than the cup, so measure first.

Swipe through 👉 Muddy paws in the car?
Covers the back seat like a hammock.
Good for car trips with a dog.

posts.brief: Retractable cat wand with feather refills and Tall sisal cat scratching post (50 inch)
posts.caption: A feather wand for playtime and a tall post for scratching, so the sofa gets a break.

Vet trip stress?
This expandable cat backpack carrier: soft backpack carrier that expands.
Good for: vet trips, short travel. Not for: anyone flying, until you check your airline's size rules.

posts.brief: Collapsible silicone travel bowl with clip and Leash-clip bag and treat holder
posts.caption: Two small things for better walks: a folding water bowl and a pouch for bags and treats, both clip to the lead.

Cat gulps food?
This ceramic slow-feeder cat bowl: wide, shallow bowl with a maze pattern slows each bite.
Good for: fast eaters, whisker-friendly shallow bowl. Not for: cats that ignore maze bowls, and anyone who needs a bigger portion.

Swipe through 👉 Cat loves the window?
Window-mounted seat for watching outside.
Good for indoor cats, sunny windows.

Big dog, low bowl?
This height-adjustable raised dog bowls: stand lifts the bowls, with several height settings.
Good for: medium and large dogs. Not for: very small dogs, if the lowest setting is still too high.

posts.brief: Wobble lick bowl for treats and wet food
posts.caption:
Swipe through 👉 Dinner gone in seconds?
Spread food in the bowl so licking takes longer.
Good for mealtime, bath time and quiet time.

posts.brief: Retractable cat wand with feather refills
posts.caption:
Bored indoor cat?
This retractable cat wand with feather refills: wand toy with spare feather and worm heads.
Good for: play sessions with an indoor cat. Not for: cats that chew toys, so put it away after play.

posts.brief: Dog paw cleaner cup (medium) and Back-seat hammock car cover
posts.caption: Rainy days mean muddy paws. A paw cup cleans them at the door, and a seat cover keeps the car clean.

Hard to jump up?
This folding wooden dog ramp: a ramp gives a gentler way up.
Good for: small and older dogs, beds and couches. Not for: furniture taller than the ramp reaches, so check the heights.

posts.brief: Collapsible silicone travel bowl with clip
posts.caption:
No water on walks?
This collapsible silicone travel bowl with clip: folds flat and clips to a bag or leash.
Good for: hikes, car trips and parks. Not for: very big dogs on the small size, so check the cup size.

posts.brief: Escape-resistant cat harness and leash and Suction-cup cat window hammock
posts.caption: A harness for short supervised walks outside, and a window seat for watching the world inside.

posts.brief: Tall sisal cat scratching post (50 inch)
posts.caption:
Swipe through 👉 Sofa scratched again?
Tall, heavy-based post cats can stretch against.
Good for large cats, scratching on the sofa.

Hands full on walks?
This leash-clip bag and treat holder: clips to the leash and holds bags and treats.
Good for: daily walks. Not for: anyone who wants a big pouch, since it is small.

Swipe through 👉 Litter on the floor?
Mat catches litter from paws before it spreads.
Good for cats that kick litter.

Dark evening walks?
This no-pull reflective dog harness: padded harness with reflective trim and a handle.
Good for: daily walks, evening walks. Not for: dogs between sizes, so measure chest and neck first.

posts.brief: Wobble lick bowl for treats and wet food and Height-adjustable raised dog bowls
posts.caption: A lick bowl makes food last longer. A raised stand helps bigger dogs eat without bending low.

Cat wants outside?
This escape-resistant cat harness and leash: snug harness and leash for supervised walks.
Good for: calm cats, supervised time outside. Not for: cats that panic in a harness, or loose fits.

posts.brief: Wobble lick bowl for treats and wet food
posts.caption:
Dinner gone in seconds?
This wobble lick bowl for treats and wet food: spread food in the bowl so licking takes longer.
Good for: mealtime, bath time and quiet time. Not for: dogs that chew or tear soft rubber.

Swipe through 👉 Vet trip stress?
Soft backpack carrier that expands.
Good for vet trips, short travel.

posts.brief: Double-layer cat litter mat and Ceramic slow-feeder cat bowl
posts.caption: A litter mat catches most of the mess by the box, and a slow-feeder bowl helps fast eaters.

Cat loves the window?
This suction-cup cat window hammock: window-mounted seat for watching outside.
Good for: indoor cats, sunny windows. Not for: very heavy cats, or windows the cups cannot grip.
